selector.rationale: The lesion's involvement and expansion of Meckel's cave, smooth remodeling and erosion of the left petrous apex, and location at the cerebellopontine angle are most consistent with a trigeminal schwannoma.

rejected.label: Hemangioblastoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence supporting this diagnosis

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: No mention of dural tail or other characteristic features

rejected.label: Chordoma
rejected.why: Absence of typical midline location and clival involvement
